title: Overhaul connection/call system to relay-based (no ICE/TURN)
summary: Replaced the PeerJS/WebRTC P2P architecture with a self-hosted WebSocket relay. Clients now open outbound WebSocket connections only, so calls work behind any NAT/firewall without ICE/TURN setup. Built a relay server (server/) that maps peer IDs to sockets and forwards signaling + raw 16 kHz PCM audio frames. Rewrote the client (relay.js, audio.js, capture-worklet.js, player-worklet.js, main.js) to capture mic via Web Audio, run RNNoise (with raw-mic fallback), downsample to 16 kHz, and stream PCM; playback uses a worklet ring buffer. Added busy detection, simultaneous-call (glare) handling via ID tie-break, coordinated auto-reconnect with backoff, mute + remote-mute indicator, and a "tap to enable sound" fallback for autoplay restrictions. Fixes the core "can't hear each other" failure (was caused by the old code stripping PeerJS's TURN servers and an unsuspended AudioContext producing silence).
userVisibleChange: Reliable calling across restrictive networks; "Friend is busy" instead of silent timeouts; automatic reconnect on drops; fixed silent-mic bug.

risks.title: Full server restart drops in-progress calls
risks.mitigation: reconnect is bounded by a 30s grace on the server; a restart loses call state, handled by ending the call cleanly rather than hanging.

risks.title: Bandwidth vs Opus
risks.mitigation: PCM is heavier than Opus; fine for personal 1:1 use. Opus/WASM can be added later if needed.

timeline.title: Diagnosed root causes (TURN stripped, suspended AudioContext)
timeline.summary: Reviewed main.js, peerjs bundle config, and identified the two core failures.

timeline.title: Built relay server + client modules
timeline.summary: Wrote server.js, relay.js, audio.js, capture/player worklets, rewrote main.js and index.html.

timeline.title: Protocol + syntax + build validation
timeline.summary: Simulated two peers against the relay (all pass), syntax-checked modules, confirmed Rust compiles.

decisions.title: Relay over WebRTC
decisions.rationale: User chose a self-hosted relay to avoid ICE/TURN entirely; they will host the server. Outbound WebSocket crosses any NAT, eliminating the silent-audio class of bugs.

decisions.title: PCM at 16 kHz instead of Opus
decisions.rationale: Simpler and more robust (no extra WASM codec dependency); ~256 kbps/leg is acceptable for 1:1 voice and keeps RNNoise (which needs 48 kHz) in the pipeline via downsampling.
